q: Do I need prior experience in yoga or meditation?
a: None at all. The program is designed for complete beginners as much as seasoned practitioners. Just show up with an open mind for all three days.
No. The Happiness Program draws from Vedic wisdom but is completely secular. People of all faiths — and none — participate and benefit equally.
Each of the three days runs a few hours; the current online evening batch is 6:00–8:30 PM IST. Timings are shown with each batch.
